case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests frequently praised the hotel's central location, friendly staff, daily cleaning and generally positive breakfast offerings. Recurring negatives included noise from the square/trams and nightlife, and small rooms with limited storage, tiny bathrooms or poor daylight. Several reviewers also noted crowded breakfast service. Isolated comments referenced elevator inconvenience, inability to pay by card, and a surprise luggage-storage fee.
